subject: The Designed Manufactured Installed promise
hook: Sketch, saw, screwdriver: one team the whole way
ig:
Sketch, saw, screwdriver: one team the whole way.

Designed, manufactured, installed. It's on everything we do, and this is what it looks like in under 30 seconds.

Designed with you at a free consultation, then checked in 3D so you can see it before anything's cut.

Manufactured in our own workshop in Hanley: cut on the panel saw, edged, drilled, assembled and quality-checked before it leaves.

Installed by our own team, who scribe fillers to your walls, level everything and adjust the doors before they go.

Why it matters: the people fitting your furniture know exactly how it was designed and built. If anything on site needs a decision, it's made by people who understand the whole job.

Follow along for more from the workshop, and send us a message when you're ready to start.
fb:
Designed, manufactured, installed. Here's the whole journey in half a minute.

We sit down with you and design the piece, check it in 3D, then make it in our own Hanley workshop: cut, edged, drilled, assembled and checked. Our own team then fits it, scribing it to your walls and adjusting every door.

It means the people in your home know exactly how your furniture was planned and built. Find out more about us and the workshop here:
https://superiofurniture.com/about/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=whole-home-bespoke-solutions&utm_content=day-331
